To find the value of  
$$
\mathbf{A} \begin{pmatrix} -13 \\ 3 \\ 4 \end{pmatrix},
$$
we are given two key equations involving the matrix $\mathbf{A}$ and specific vectors:

$$
\mathbf{A} \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 4 \\ -3 \end{pmatrix}, \quad \mathbf{A} \begin{pmatrix} -5 \\ 2 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -5 \\ -5 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

---

### Step 1: Express the target vector as a linear combination of the given vectors

We aim to write the vector  
$$
\begin{pmatrix} -13 \\ 3 \\ 4 \end{pmatrix}
$$  
as a linear combination of the two known vectors:  
$$
\begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix}, \quad \begin{pmatrix} -5 \\ 2 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

Let us assume:
$$
\begin{pmatrix} -13 \\ 3 \\ 4 \end{pmatrix} = a \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} + b \begin{pmatrix} -5 \\ 2 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

This gives the system of equations:
$$
\begin{aligned}
3a - 5b &= -13 \quad \text{(1)} \\
a + 2b &= 3 \quad \text{(2)} \\
2b &= 4 \quad \text{(3)}
\end{aligned}
$$

From equation (3), we solve:
$$
2b = 4 \Rightarrow b = 2.
$$

Substitute $b = 2$ into equation (2):
$$
a + 2(2) = 3 \Rightarrow a + 4 = 3 \Rightarrow a = -1.
$$

Now check equation (1):
$$
3(-1) - 5(2) = -3 - 10 = -13 \quad \text{✓}
$$

Thus, the vector can be written as:
$$
\begin{pmatrix} -13 \\ 3 \\ 4 \end{pmatrix} = -1 \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} + 2 \begin{pmatrix} -5 \\ 2 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

---

### Step 2: Apply the matrix $\mathbf{A}$ to this linear combination

Using the linearity of matrix multiplication:
$$
\mathbf{A} \begin{pmatrix} -13 \\ 3 \\ 4 \end{pmatrix} = -1 \mathbf{A} \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} + 2 \mathbf{A} \begin{pmatrix} -5 \\ 2 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

$$
= -1 \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 4 \\ -3 \end{pmatrix} + 2 \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -5 \\ -5 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

$$
-1 \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 4 \\ -3 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ -4 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix}, \quad
2 \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -5 \\ -5 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -10 \\ -10 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

Add them together:
$$
\begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ -4 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix} + \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -10 \\ -10 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ -14 \\ -7 \end{pmatrix}.
$$
